test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 24 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following is not correct about Article 19 of the Indian Constitution?

options.text: All citizens shall have the right to form associations or unions.
All citizens shall have the right to assemble peaceably and without arms
All citizens shall have the right to move freely outside the territory of India.
All citizens shall have the right to freedom of speech and expression.

solution:
The correct answer is __**All citizens shall have the right to move freely outside the territory of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 19** of the Indian Constitution guarantees certain fundamental rights related to freedom of speech and expression, assembly, association, movement, residence, and the right to practice any profession or occupation. All citizens shall have the following right:-
 
• **Article 19(1)(a): **Freedom of Speech and Expression:
 
• This clause protects the right of citizens to freely express their thoughts, opinions, and ideas through speech, writing, printing, or any other form of communication.
 
• **Article 19(1)(b): **Freedom to Assemble Peaceably:
 
• Citizens have the right to assemble peacefully and without arms. This includes the right to hold meetings, demonstrations, and processions.
 
• **Article 19(1)(c): **Freedom to Form Associations or Unions:
 
• Citizens have the right to form associations, unions, or cooperative societies. This right allows individuals to come together for common interests or causes.
 
• **Article 19(1)(d): **Freedom to Move Freely:
 
• This clause guarantees the right to move freely throughout the territory of India. Citizens have the freedom to reside and settle in any part of the country.
 
• **Article 19(1)(e):** Freedom to Reside and Settle:
 
• Citizens have the right to reside and settle in any part of the country. This includes the right to choose one's place of residence and the right to move freely within the country.
 
• **Article 19(1)(g): **Freedom to Practice any Profession or Occupation:
 
• Citizens have the right to practice any profession, or to carry on any occupation, trade, or business. However, this right is subject to certain reasonable restrictions.
